name: icloud-hme-manager
description: iCloud Hide My Email CLI Manager - Manage your iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses from the command line

scripts.build: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64,node18-macos-x64,node18-linux-x64 --output dist/icloud-hme
scripts.build:win: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/icloud-hme-win
scripts.build:mac: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-macos-x64 --output dist/icloud-hme-macos
scripts.build:linux: npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs --targets node18-linux-x64 --output dist/icloud-hme-linux
